proposedOperatorData.name: Anglesey Adventures
proposedOperatorData.tagline: The original coasteering company on the Anglesey coast, based in Holyhead.
proposedOperatorData.description:
Anglesey Adventures was the first company to offer coasteering in North Wales and has operated on the Anglesey coastline for decades. All activities run from a single base at Anglesey Outdoors on Porthdafarch Road, Holyhead, which has changing facilities, toilets, and hot showers on site.

The operator runs a wide range of half-day and full-day activities including coasteering (standard, adventure, explorer, and RIB-boat variants), sit-on-top kayaking, sea kayaking, gorge scrambling, rock climbing, abseiling, mountain days, raft building, and MEGA SUP. Instructors are AALA-licensed, NGB-qualified, DBS-checked, and first-aid trained.
proposedOperatorData.uniqueSellingPoint: The first and longest-running coasteering operator in North Wales, with its own dedicated base offering hot showers and changing facilities on Anglesey.
